segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may respond.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: We developed the National AI Strategy.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: And in that development, there are four major components.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: The first is the AI factory, the infrastructure, the human resources, the policies, and of course the financing.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Out of it, we will have to develop the AI refinery, developing the models, the analytics between government, national, local, academic, and industry partners.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Now, to really implement and accelerate.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: The application of AI, we need to have partnerships at the local, regional, and national level, and of course, international partnership.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: All of this are geared into really helping our own enterprises and the community.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: So, we also crafted the National AI Implementation Strategy, where different government organizations will take the lead.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: On DOST, we lead in the development of the infrastructure for research and development.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: And talent management, and development of language models that can be utilized together with DTI and DICT, and the industry by various enterprises.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Now, DICT is involved in the connectivity and infrastructure as well, but they are mainly dealing with the private sector to support this.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Magkaiba po talaga ang laro namin.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Now, to support the AI sovereignty, DOST is also developing.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: The data sovereignty through the Geospatial Analytics and Technology Solutions platform.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: It's a digital transformation of all data anchored on geographic information system, the science of where.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: And this is where we differentiate DOST from the rest of other government agencies.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: We are developing this data that will be utilized to fuel the artificial intelligence technology.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: So, eventually, our goal is to develop a geospatial.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: GeoAI Hub, managed by DOST, so that we can provide our enterprises and the government Philippine-owned data that will be queried by large language models or language models that we develop.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: Currently, we have iTanong as a language model that can be utilized by anyone who would want to look at it.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: We also have an equivalent of the App Store or Google.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: We also have a Google Play Store where language models using Filipino data sets are placed there so that one can look at it and see if you have similar operation.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: You can use that model para i-short circuit na po natin yung lack of compute power and scale.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: So, gamitin nyo na lang yun, pwede mo nang patakbuhin yung operation mo using that model.

segments.speaker: DOST Secretary Renato U. Solidum Jr.
segments.text: So iyon po ang current state ng AI strategy ng DOST.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So when I hear about the scholars and the grants and the—and the stipends, parang ako, ah, okay, at one point in my life talagang nagbenepisyo ako doon sa stipends namin sa PISAY.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which at the time was ₱500 per month.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Pero ngayon, magkano na po? Four or five na, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ₱2,000 na po iyong minimum. At that time, ₱500 per month po kami noon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Pero laking bagay po noon talaga sa amin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So again, I would like to commend DOST and please know you have partners who will advocate for your budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you very much po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: we terminate the budget briefing of the Department of Science and Technology and its attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amben S. Amante
segments.text: It has been moved and seconded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sorry, hindi tayo makakauwi nang wala 'tong other motion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amben S. Amante
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honors, and to our—and to our colleagues from the Department of Science and Technology for your valuable participation

segments.speaker: Rep. Amben S. Amante
segments.text: We, we likewise thank to the members of the Committee for their active participation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Ah, Mr. Chair, uh, I move that we suspend the Committee proceedings and resume tomorrow, August 25, 2026, 9 a.m.

segments.speaker: Rep. Amben S. Amante
